convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iATR indicator, simple random entry logic, fixed/ATR-based SL/TP with risk-percent sizing, no external .mqh libraries for trading logic (Trade.mqh is standard MT5), no grid/martingale/hedging, single position management.

derived_values.name: pip_point - pip value adjusted for 3/5 digit brokers
derived_values.used_by: SL/TP distance calculation, breakeven activation distance

derived_values.name: stop_level - minimum stop distance with 10-point buffer
freeze_level - minimum freeze distance with 10-point buffer

other_exits: breakeven_move: when price moves breakeven_distance pips in favor, SL is moved to entry price (open_price). Only activated once per position via breakeven_activated flag.

params.margin_fallback: if insufficient margin and use_max_margin=true, calculate max lot from available margin with 10% buffer

position_sizing.conditional_logic: When use_max_margin=true and free_margin < required_margin, lot size is recalculated to maximum possible from available margin. When false, trade is rejected if margin insufficient.

custom_logic_notes: This is a random-direction EA - entry direction is determined by MathRand() % 2 with no technical analysis signal. It maintains exactly one position at a time (PositionsTotal()==0 to enter, PositionsTotal()==1 for breakeven check). The breakeven mechanism moves SL to entry price once price travels breakeven_distance pips in favor, but only once per position (guarded by breakeven_activated flag). The CTradeValidation class adds 10*point buffer to both stop_level and freeze_level from broker values. SL/TP validation checks broker minimum distances before order placement and before SL modification. The default CTrade filling mode is FOK.
python_conversion_notes: Random entry EA with no indicator-based signal logic - simplest possible conversion. Key complexity: (1) pip_point digit adjustment must replicate MQL5 logic (digits 2/3 -> point, digits 4/5 -> point*10); (2) SL/TP validation against broker stop_level/freeze_level with 10-point buffer; (3) lot sizing formula requires tick_value from symbol info; (4) margin check with fallback to max-possible-lot calculation; (5) breakeven is a one-time SL move to entry price, not a trailing stop. No new-bar guard means the EA attempts entry on every tick when flat - in Python backtesting, decide whether to sample per-tick or per-bar. ATR mode reads atr_array[0] (current bar) so needs real-time ATR value at entry time.
